mapper.sql: SELECT c.*,f.factory_name FROM metal_customer c JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=c.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE c.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: AND c.factory_id=#{factoryId} ORDER BY c.customer_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_customer SET customer_name=#{name},company_name=#{companyName},address=#{address},contact_name=#{contactName},contact_phone=#{contactPhone},department=#{department},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE customer_id=#{id} AND factory_id=#{factoryId} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE metal_customer SET del_flag='2',version=version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE customer_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
